_comment: Attach this to the IAM user/role that runs `terraform apply` for this repo. It is intentionally broader than the runtime least-privilege policies inside the modules themselves (those govern what the deployed Lambdas can do; this governs what the DEPLOYER can do). Scope resource ARNs down further once you know your account ID and chosen project_name/environment prefix.

Statement._comment_scope: Tighten this to arn:aws:iam::<account-id>:role/<project_name>-* and :policy/<project_name>-* once you know those values -- left broad here only because project_name is a variable, not a fixed value this static file can reference.

Statement._comment: Read-only VPC lookups plus security-group management -- this repo does NOT create/delete VPCs or subnets themselves, only references existing ones.
